# Purpose
This file defines the metric metadata table `FD_METRICS_GOSSIP` for the gossip subsystem. It is generated by `gen_metrics.py`, so it lists metric names, metric types such as `COUNTER` and `GAUGE`, and enum labels for grouped values like `PING_TRACKED_TYPE`, `PONG_RESPONSE`, `CRDS_VALUE`, `GOSSIP_CRDS_OUTCOME`, and `GOSSIP_MESSAGE`. The table covers gossip activity for ping tracking, CRDS storage and peer state, message transmit and receive counts, and byte totals for push and pull response traffic. The file does not contain runtime logic; it only provides the static metric definitions used by the rest of the program.
